meaning: The wallet that sealed the model.
The model's name, 1 to 32 bytes: lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens.
The manifest as compact UTF-8 JSON, up to 4,096 bytes. A `sketch` manifest leaves out the fields that equal the sketch defaults.
The Weights accounts in order, 1 to 64.
The length of the ciphertext across all Weights accounts.
The cipher id, `xchacha20poly1305-64k-v1`.
The 16-byte nonce prefix of the weights cipher.
Ciphertext root hash (`hash_version = 0`: flat SHA-256; `hash_version = 1`: 64 KiB chunk Merkle root). All zero until the model is sealed.
The measurements allowed to open the model, 1 to 8.
The price of one unit (one call when `price_unit` is `Call`, or one output token when `Token`), in base units of the price mint.
The mint the price is paid in. The default (all-zero) address means SOL.
The operator's share of the price, in basis points.
The primary key allowed to write the ciphertext. The default address once the model is sealed.
`Uploading`, `Sealed`, `Live` or `Retired`.
The slot the model was created in.
The slot the model was sealed in. 0 until then.
How many calls to the model have settled.
The PDA bump.
Every key authorized to write the ciphertext, 1 to 8 (starts with `upload_key`). Empty once the model is sealed.
`0` for legacy flat SHA-256 across all ciphertext bytes; `1` for the 64 KiB chunk binary Merkle root.
Count of 65,552-byte ciphertext chunks folded into `merkle_frontier` so far during range sealing.
Incremental binary Merkle peaks (up to 20 hashes) maintained across `seal_range` calls and cleared on `seal_model`.
Bitmask of occupied levels in `merkle_frontier`, cleared to 0 on `seal_model`.
Optional `ModelBase` (`sha256`, `size_bytes`, `format`, `source`) binding a sealed adapter to a public open-weight base model. `None` for standalone models.
Whether `price` is charged per `Call` (`0`) or per output `Token` (`1`).

True when an active Policy PDA exists for this model (`["policy", model]`). When true, `open_call`, `open_metered_call`, `grant_by_owner` and `grant_by_enclave` require the Policy PDA in remaining accounts.
